<main class="page-main"><section class="inner-hero reveal"><div class="page-kicker">03 / APPROACH</div><h1 class="page-title">How I think about an<br><em>analytical project.</em></h1></section><section class="approach-wrap"><div class="approach-head reveal"><h2>Methodology should serve the decision.</h2><p>The objective is not to use the most complex model, but to build enough robust, testable and operational evidence to improve a concrete decision.</p></div><div class="approach-list"><article class="reveal"><span>01</span><h3>Understand the decision</h3><p>Define which decision should improve, who makes it and what constraints exist before modeling.</p></article><article class="reveal"><span>02</span><h3>Design the evidence</h3><p>Select data, variables and methodology with traceability, robustness and validation in mind.</p></article><article class="reveal"><span>03</span><h3>Test before trusting</h3><p>Backtesting, alternative comparisons, sensitivity analysis and documentation are part of development.</p></article><article class="reveal"><span>04</span><h3>Turn it into a product</h3><p>The result should be usable: dashboard, application, automation, report or reproducible process.</p></article></div></section></main>
